fields.label: Enable Transcripts And AI
fields.description: Transcripts, summaries, highlights and SOPs are made in the recording owner's browser with open-source models. Nothing runs on this server unless an Ollama server is set below.

fields.label: Speech Model
fields.description: Downloaded once by each browser: tiny ~75 MB, base ~145 MB, small ~480 MB.

fields.label: Writing Model
fields.description: Writes summaries, highlights and SOPs in the browser (needs WebGPU). Downloaded once: 0.5B ~0.4 GB, 1.5B ~1 GB, 3B ~2 GB.

fields.label: Ollama URL
fields.description: e.g. http://localhost:11434. When set, summaries and SOPs can be made on that server for devices without WebGPU, and viewers can ask questions.
